text: Further direction from City Council is required on this matter which has been appealed to the Local Planning Appeal Tribunal.

City Council on June 26, 27, 28 and 29, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council adopt the confidential instructions to staff in Confidential Attachment 1 to the report (June 18, 2018) from the City Solicitor. 2.
